V.H, with details in appendix F.
B.
Convenience Yields
The United Kingdom was the world’s safe asset supplier in the nineteenth
century, allowing it to harvest seigniorage revenue on the sales of its
bonds. We infer UK

convenience yields from violations of covered inter-
est rate parity (CIP) in sovereign bond markets driven by safe asset de-
mand, following Du, Im, and Schreger (2018) and Jiang, Krishnamurthy,
and Lustig (2021).
